body:
This independent-verification contribution computes the exact prescribed-triple deletion minimum at **p=6** without assuming the four-block reduction. It exhausts **301,989,888 normalized decoder-coefficient assignments**, covers **19 target orbits / 34,220 triples**, and checks **433 one-port-restoration failures** by separate row-space calculations. No new classification, kappa or paid supplier is claimed.

## Contribution and concurrent work

The theorem statements in **PR966 (@woklerx)** and expanded **PR669 (Sam Sung / @the-missionary-company)** subsume our independently developed p>=5 theorem. The additional contribution is a different finite optimum computation:

| Package | Independent optimization coverage relevant here |
| --- | --- |
| PR669, head `8f4600b` | Coefficient enumeration at p=4; smaller retained-graph checks. |
| PR966, head `7eaf5665` | RREF enumeration through p=5; its primary partition census also covers p=6. |
| PR971, head `b4cb9709` (Eva Ayala / @ToikY) | Targetwise minima at p=3,4; independent inventory and supplied-witness audits through p=6. |
| This package | Unrestricted coefficient optimization at p=5,6, including independent p=6 minima and restoration checks. |

PR971's explicit group-action and histogram-preserving corruption controls are credited. Inventory or witness checking alone is not claimed as new. No concurrent implementation or numerical receipt is imported, and no priority claim is made. The concurrent code and receipts were inspected; their full packages and broader theorems were not replayed or certified here.

## Model and method

The model is the binary nonempty k=2 proper-star decoder. Vertices are `0,...,2p-1`, with original mates `{2i,2i+1}`; ports join nonmates. Surviving inputs are unrestricted and all three target ports must survive. The empty-star/global-sum observation is excluded.

The independent search assigns each vertex a label in `F2^3`. Target-edge label differences are normalized to the three unit vectors; every nontarget edge with a nonzero difference must be deleted. A common label translation is fixed, then all remaining assignments are enumerated without pruning. This permits all eight labels and does not invoke the four-block theorem. Separate Python orbit canonicalization and Gaussian elimination check the results and restoration controls.

The retained proof for p>=5 gives: target triangles impossible; a three-edge path on two complete original matched pairs costs `6p-11`; every other three-edge forest costs `6p-12`. For example, at p=5 targets `{0,2},{0,3},{1,2}` cost 19 instead of 18. These statements are already covered by the credited concurrent work.

Start with `research/prescribed-star-triples/README-INDEPENDENT.md`, `run_independent.py`, `label_scan.cpp` and `INDEPENDENT.json`. `PROOF.md`, `verify.py` and `CERTIFICATE.json` retain the independent derivation and primary comparison. `SOURCES.json`, `NOTICE` and `VALIDATION.md` document pins, credit, scope and actual results.

## Reproduce and actual validation

Offline: Python 3.10+ standard library; the first command also requires C++17.

```sh
python3 -I -B research/prescribed-star-triples/run_independent.py
python3 -I -B research/prescribed-star-triples/verify.py
python3 -I -O -B research/prescribed-star-triples/test_package.py
```

All passed on Linux, CPython 3.12.14 and g++ 14.2.0:

- Independent p=5,6: **306,446,336 assignments**, 740 restoration controls, full deterministic receipt agreement. All 224 p=2,3 triples also pass exhaustive deletion-mask checks; smaller cases remain finite boundary controls.
- Primary: **44,100 triples**, 37 orbits, **645,606 partitions**, 3,060 literal input columns, 740 restoration rejections and three other invalid-decoder controls. Expected marker: `PASS_PRESCRIBED_STAR_TRIPLES`.
- Three package tests, optimized isolated staged-blob replays, source/receipt corruption rejection, overwrite protection, warning-enabled compilation and selected-record integrity pass.
- Full **`make verify` passed** at original contribution `70484032ff4ae960b19acc8e159622e7e6ac8bac`: 18 sequential groups, 87 isolated test modules, 20 historical patch checks. A compact receipt and full-log hash are committed. Later commits change documentation/provenance only.

The full package applies cleanly to main `bbc600db`. This is not a full-suite run on current main. Historical PR741 replay admission was separately checked against the gate pinned at `0076643`. No selected PR799/890/942 cold replay, hosted CI or proof-assistant validation is claimed.

## Provenance, review and limits

Exact research base: `91a2094f2e022930069e8cfdc810a3ea1b81cd09`. Original PR669 source pin: `7d526020fc368ce4157cd436995c2f4fcf683318`. Its two proof texts remain byte-identical and retained with SHA256/Git-blob pins. SOURCES.json records the full current PR669/966/971 comparison heads as well.

The exact contributor guide at `47481c8` is unchanged. The central ledger was consulted during research; the separately linked historical contribution-review index was consulted during the follow-up, not before building. That timing is disclosed in VALIDATION. Final two-agent review through **PR974 at 11:30 a.m. EDT, October 13, 2026** found no further overlap; current main selects PR942. Only this research directory is added; supplier constructions and `upstream/` are unchanged.

Source access, preparation, helpers, frames, copies, dirty restoration, recursive children, hosting and complete assembly remain unpriced. Empty-star, higher-k and broader forest results are outside this verification. Inherited compiler and analytic obligations are not discharged.

Prepared for **@DLamdata** with substantial **OpenAI Codex assistance** in mathematical development, implementation, independent computation, adversarial review, and writing. **Claude Code** subsequently reviewed the contribution. These reviews were AI-assisted; no independent human review is claimed.

Licensed under **Apache-2.0**. The package’s attribution and source records credit PR669, PR966, PR971, GamingPuzzled, icekylinx, eumemic, and the cited graph-code research.
title: Independent verification: exhaustive p=6 prescribed-star triple budgets
